title: CYBRIK Resilience Policy Contract Schema
description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 defining cross-product resilience policy contracts, exponential backoff parameters, circuit breaker thresholds, and fault-injection qualification bounds.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for transient errors.

max_backoff_seconds.description: Maximum backoff duration cap in seconds.

backoff_multiplier.description: Exponential multiplier applied to backoff interval.

jitter.description: Whether to apply pseudo-random jitter to backoff delay.

circuit_breaker.description: Circuit breaker policy parameters governing state transitions and recovery probing.

failure_threshold.description: Number of consecutive failures required to trip circuit breaker from CLOSED to OPEN.

recovery_timeout_seconds.description: Cooldown period in seconds before probing downstream health in HALF_OPEN state.

half_open_max_calls.description: Maximum trial calls permitted during HALF_OPEN probe state.

consecutive_successes_to_close.description: Number of consecutive successful trial calls needed to reset circuit breaker to CLOSED.

retryable_status_codes.description: HTTP status codes considered transient and eligible for retry.

retryable_exceptions.description: Exception type names considered transient and eligible for retry.
